root_cause: All 4 failures are the same gtest: ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices (smoke_ScatterUpdateGeneralPathOutOfRangeIndices suite), covering the f32/i32 input precisions x i32/i64 index precisions combinations. The test builds a ScatterUpdate op with an out-of-range index constant (value 100000 against a data dim of 8) and expects both the CPU plugin execution (get_plugin_outputs) and the reference/template execution (calculate_refs) to throw ov::Exception via OV_EXPECT_THROW. The failure ("Expected exception ov::Exception" with no exception captured) means neither OV_EXPECT_THROW assertion triggered for at least one of the two calls, i.e. no exception was thrown where one was required. The triggering commit (PR #39679) only touches the GPU plugin's oneDNN 1D group-convolution post-op rank handling (src/plugins/intel_gpu, onednn integration) and is unrelated to CPU ScatterUpdate bounds checking, so this failure is very unlikely to be caused by that change. This points to a pre-existing bounds-check regression/flakiness in the CPU ScatterUpdate out-of-range-index validation path (or the reference/template plugin's bounds check) rather than a new code change in this commit; it may have been introduced by an earlier, unrelated change to ScatterUpdate validation/shape-inference, or it is an environment-specific (Windows Release) behavior difference versus other platforms.
reproduction_steps: Build the CPU plugin tests on Windows (VS 2022, Release) and run: ov_cpu_func_tests.exe --gtest_filter="smoke_ScatterUpdateGeneralPathOutOfRangeIndices/ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices*" -- this should reproduce the missing-exception failure if it is a genuine CPU/reference bug; if it does NOT reproduce locally/on Linux, the failure is likely Windows-Release-specific or transiently environment-dependent.
recommended_actions: Reproduce locally on Windows Release and on Linux to confirm whether the missing out-of-range exception is platform-specific.

Inspect ScatterUpdate shape/bounds validation in src/plugins/intel_cpu (and the ov::reference ScatterUpdate implementation used by the template/reference plugin) for a recent change that may have relaxed or removed the out-of-range index check for the general (non-fast-path) case.

Check CheckPluginRelatedResults / compile_model() behavior: confirm whether validation now happens at a later stage (e.g., only during generate_inputs of a different shape) causing the exception to not be raised for the indices_shape=[2] general path case specifically.
Add temporary verbose logging/asserts in a local debug build to see which of OV_EXPECT_THROW(get_plugin_outputs()) vs OV_EXPECT_THROW(calculate_refs()) is failing to throw.

If confirmed pre-existing/flaky and unrelated to recent merges, consider filing a tracking ticket and temporarily marking the test disabled on Windows with a reference to the ticket, pending root-cause fix.
prevention_strategies: Add out-of-range-index bounds validation unit tests directly at the ov::op::v3::ScatterUpdate shape-inference / validate_and_infer_types level (not only end-to-end CPU functional tests) so that regressions in bounds checking are caught at the unit-test level closer to the source, with clearer platform-independent failure signals. Add CI coverage comparing CPU vs TEMPLATE plugin exception behavior explicitly in the test name/output to make it immediately clear which backend failed to throw.
historical_context: No prior investigation records or patterns found for a ScatterUpdate out-of-range-indices failure in this database; this is the first recorded occurrence of this signature.
